facts.fact: Insights is available on Business and Enterprise plans.
facts.quote: Available on:** Business and Enterprise plans

facts.fact: Insights is accessible to workspace admins and owners.
facts.quote: Access:** Workspace admins and owners

facts.fact: Viewing or exporting Insights data does not consume credits.
facts.quote: Insights does not consume credits, whether you view it or export its data.

facts.fact: Lovable changed how it counts app visits on October 26, 2026, so most apps show more visits from that day onward.
facts.quote: On October 26, 2026, Lovable changed how it counts visits, so most apps show more visits from that day.

facts.fact: Lovable begins aggregating Insights numbers once a day, around 09:30 UTC, and each update includes activity through the previous day.
facts.quote: Lovable starts aggregating these numbers once a day, around 09:30 UTC, then publishes them to Insights after processing finishes.

facts.fact: Data for a newly active Business or Enterprise workspace typically appears within a day of its first activity.
facts.quote: Data typically appears within a day of the workspace’s first activity on a Business or Enterprise plan.

facts.fact: The Weekly chart view shows one value per week for the last 12 weeks, with weeks starting on Monday.
facts.quote: Weeks start on Monday.

facts.fact: The Monthly chart view shows one value per month for the last 12 months, and the Daily view shows the last 30 days.
facts.quote: Monthly** shows one value per month for the last 12 months.

facts.fact: An app's edit total on the Top apps card counts edits since January 1, 2025 and is not limited to the last 30 days.
facts.quote: the app’s total edits since January 1, 2025.

facts.fact: A visit is counted each time one person opens a published app, so returning visitors and reloads count as additional visits.
facts.quote: A **visit** is one person opening a published app.

facts.fact: Active builders counts only workspace members who built something in the last 30 days, while the builders list shows all members.
facts.quote: **Active builders** counts only the members who built something in the last 30 days.

facts.fact: An unpublished app counts as an active app when edited but shows no visits.
facts.quote: An unpublished app still counts as an active app when someone edits it, but it shows no visits.

facts.fact: One connection used by two apps is counted twice in the Connections added metric.
facts.quote: One connection used by two apps counts twice.

facts.fact: The full app list and full builder list can be exported to a CSV file.
facts.quote: Export the full app list or the full builder list to a CSV file for reporting and leadership reviews.

facts.fact: Insights counts an app's edits from January 1, 2025 onward, and this total matches the figure on the Top apps card.
facts.quote: the app’s total edits since January 1, 2025, the same figure as on the Top apps card.

facts.fact: The All apps list shows 25 rows per page by default and can be set to show 25, 50, or 100 rows per page.
facts.quote: Show 25, 50, or 100 rows per page. The page shows 25 rows by default.

facts.fact: The All apps list sorts by visits by default.
facts.quote: The list sorts by visits by default.

facts.fact: The All builders list sorts by edits by default.
facts.quote: The list sorts by edits by default.

facts.fact: The Builders table's Edit activity column shows a week-by-week view of a member's building activity over the last 12 weeks.
facts.quote: a week-by-week view of the member’s building activity over the last 12 weeks.

facts.fact: An app's App visits count only includes visits to apps the member owns, so a member who edits an app owned by someone else adds to Edits but not App visits.
facts.quote: A member who edits an app someone else owns adds to their own **Edits** but not to their **App visits**.

facts.fact: The Credits (30d) column appears in the All builders table only when credit data is available for the workspace.
facts.quote: This column appears only when credit data is available for the workspace.

facts.fact: A member counts as building in Adoption by department when they edited an app in the last 30 days.
facts.quote: A member counts as building when they edited an app in the last 30 days.

facts.fact: The Adoption by department card shows only the three largest departments; workspaces with more departments can open the full list.
facts.quote: The card shows the three largest departments.

facts.fact: Members without an identity provider department are grouped under Unassigned at the end of the adoption list.
facts.quote: members whose identity provider record has no department appear in an **Unassigned** group at the end.

facts.fact: Insights numbers are updated once a day and include activity through the previous day.
facts.quote: The numbers are updated once a day and include activity through the previous day.

facts.fact: CSV exports of All apps and All builders always cover every app or member in the workspace, ignoring search, filters, and sort order.
facts.quote: The export always covers every app or every member in the workspace.

facts.fact: An app moved to another workspace disappears from that workspace's app and builder lists immediately, while overview cards and charts keep its history until the next daily update.
facts.quote: An app that someone moves to another workspace disappears from this workspace’s app and builder lists immediately.

facts.fact: Without access to a project, App analytics is unavailable and shows the message 'You don't have access to this project.'
facts.quote: When you do not have access to a project, **App analytics** is unavailable for it and shows **You don’t have access to this project.**

facts.fact: Insights has no destructive actions; nothing done on the page deletes an app, changes a member, or spends credits.
facts.quote: Insights has no destructive actions. Nothing you do on the page deletes an app, changes a member, or spends credits.

facts.fact: Insights covers one workspace, so companies with several workspaces must review each one separately.
facts.quote: Insights covers one workspace.
